Title: Azure Virtual Desktop Insights Powered by the Azure Monitor Agent

Body.Content:
Administrators working with Azure Virtual Desktop Insights can now make use of the Azure Monitor Agent (AMA) to collect data from session hosts for our native monitoring solution. This preview introduces an updated configuration workbook experience to help orchestrate the setup and management of all required components. You can now start the transition from the Log Analytics Agent in advance of the planned End of Life (EOL) in August of 2024.
 

For additional information about the migration approach and the transition to the Azure Monitor Agent please see the documentation on migration from legacy agents. 

To review the updated configuration process for the public preview, read the Azure Virtual Desktop Insights documentation.
